title: Implement Request Logging Middleware
description: This feature adds a logging middleware to track incoming requests, providing valuable insights for debugging and performance optimization. It will log request metadata, such as method, path, and response status. This improvement enhances the framework's production-readiness and facilitates error diagnosis
testCases: Test logging for failed requests with error status
acceptance: The logging middleware must log request metadata for all incoming requests, including method, path, and response status, and must not introduce any performance regressions
reason: Implementing request logging middleware is a high-impact feature that improves the framework's production-readiness, allowing developers to diagnose issues and optimize performance more effectively
